seen.body: Split from 042fnquv5 (issue types shipped in 4.17.0). A [[mirror]] option maps ledger facts (kind, priority, area label) to extra Projects v2 fields (single-select and text): push sets them via updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue, the card pull reads them and reports a divergence when a human changes one. Part of the parity list the owner approved ('so it all, aproved'); drafted because it is a separate, larger slice on the board machinery. Off unless the mirror names a map.
seen.title: Custom Projects v2 fields: a per-mirror map to text and single-select fields
